name: Index of Industrial Production - General Index
remarks: Lag placeholder - verify against release calendar. MoSPI-downloaded files only cover 26-54% of expected months per base (a filter applied before download, not a parser defect). Gaps in the 1993-94, 2004-05, and 2011-12 bases were backfilled ONCE from an RBI DBIE export ("Index of Industrial Production.xlsx", General Index) via corrections.csv -- see the 2026-08-27 entries there, reason field cites the source. That file is intentionally not wired in as a live `bases:` source: MoSPI remains the source of truth going forward, this was a one-time gap-fill only. The 2022-23 base switched to "iip_55.xlsx" (MoSPI eSankhyiki long-format export, `mospi_iip_long`), which is complete for the months it covers (39/39, 2023-04 to 2026-06) and agrees exactly with the old file on every overlapping month -- a genuine MoSPI replacement, not a one-off. Also note: for the 1993-94 base, 31 months where MoSPI and the RBI export overlap actually disagree (MoSPI consistently higher, up to +17.6, concentrated in Jan-Jun 2005-2009) -- those were NOT touched, left on the original MoSPI value; worth a manual look if that period matters for the model.
